facts.text: Falkner was named for William Clark Falkner, the great‑grandfather of author William Faulkner.
In 1870 Colonel William Falkner celebrated the completion of his Ripley Railroad branch that ran from New Albany to Middleton.
The Falkner Heritage Museum Project, founded in 2016, aims to preserve the old town beside the tracks and build a future‑ready community center.
Cooper Hill School House, built between 1856 and 1869, is believed to be the only one‑room, one‑teacher school still standing in Tippah County.
On September 26, 2026, Falkner Heritage Park will host a Founder’s Day Car & Jeep Show featuring classic vehicles, barbecue, and a $20 donation entry.
